preconditions.description: The number of integers n must be between 3 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in numbers)
preconditions.description: All numbers in the input list must be integers between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The input list must contain exactly n numbers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (len(set(numbers)) == 1 or (len(set(numbers)) == 2 and abs(numbers[0] - numbers[1]) == 1)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: If all numbers are identical, output 'YES'. Otherwise, if there are exactly two distinct numbers differing by 1, output 'YES'. Otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (len(set(numbers)) > 2 and all(abs(x - y) == 1 for x in set(numbers) for y in set(numbers) if x != y)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: If there are more than two distinct numbers, all pairs of distinct numbers must differ by exactly 1 to output 'YES'. Otherwise, output 'NO'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if (len(set(numbers)) == 1 or (len(set(numbers)) == 2 and abs(numbers[0] - numbers[1]) == 1) or (len(set(numbers)) > 2 and all(abs(x - y) == 1 for x in set(numbers) for y in set(numbers) if x != y))) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if and only if the numbers can be arranged in a circle where every pair of neighbors differs by exactly 1. This is possible if all numbers are identical, or if there are exactly two distinct numbers differing by 1, or if all distinct numbers form a contiguous sequence of integers differing by 1.
